prerequisites_command: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y git build-essential python3-dev ffmpeg ca-certificates
optional_storage_prerequisites_command: sudo apt-get install -y sshfs openssh-client rsync
ffmpeg_note: Fresh hosts must install Ubuntu FFmpeg4.4 via apt, including its shared-library dependency closure. Setup can use that system runtime or reuse an existing validated project FFmpeg prefix; the historical22addon-package lock alone is not a complete fresh-host installation.
